The number of women in city T forms approximately what percentage of the number of men in city P?
solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Number of women in City T = 45% of 46200

⇒ Number of women in City T = (45)/(100)times 46200=20,790

⇒ Number of men in City P = 45% of 46800

⇒ Number of men in City P = (45)/(100)times 46800=21,060

⇒ Percentage formed by number of women in city T as compared to number of men in city P = (20790)/(21060)times 100=98.72

**Hence, the percentage formed by number of women in city T as compared to number of men in city P is 98.72%**
